description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended nivolumab, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for the adjuvant treatment of muscle-invasive urothelial cancer at high risk of recurrence after radical resection in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 at a level of 1% or more, when adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy is unsuitable. Nivolumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
